card.name: Degree letters after author names
card.fires_on: Pieces of academic or medical degree abbreviations after a person's name, such as the D in PhD or PharmD, the DO after a reviewer's name, or FAC in FACOG. Mostly in author and reviewer credit lines.

modes.label: Degree after name
modes.description: Part of a degree abbreviation like Ph.D, PharmD, DO, or CSCS right after a person's name in a byline or review credit.
modes.example: Reviewer: Michael J. Fucci,<< DO>> - Review Date: 09

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Occasional endings inside ordinary words, such as plural endings, with no link to credentials.
modes.example: you can do a ton of crunch<<es>> and sit-ups

card.plain: It marks the middle of a doctor's or author's degree letters, like PhD or DO, after their name.
